conversation.end_call_when: End the call once a follow-up has been agreed, once it is clear there is no news worth pitching, when the prospect says they are busy, or when they ask not to be called again. Say a short goodbye first. Never end the call before the prospect has answered the opening question, and never in the middle of your own sentence.
